```{r}
#| include: false
pkgload::load_all(Sys.getenv("APATABLES_PKG_ROOT"), quiet = TRUE)
```

LaTeX reporting the width a table really gets in journal mode: apaquarto
puts a table in its ThreePartTable environment, inside one of two columns.

```{=latex}
\begin{ThreePartTable}
APAJOULINEWIDTH=\the\linewidth
\end{ThreePartTable}
```

A table that fits an upright manuscript page at full size, and so would be
left alone by a ladder working from a 6.5 in budget, but is more than
one-and-a-half times as wide as a journal column.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-jou
#| tbl-cap: "Journal column"
#| apa-note: "A note under the journal table."
#| warning: false
apa.cor.table(attitude[, 1:4])$spec |> apa.quarto.pdf()
```
